opportunities.title: Greater Bethesda Chamber — Off the Clock & membership receptions
opportunities.whatIsHappening: Public evidence supports recurring, catering-relevant program demand but not a Bethesda Marriott booking or partnership. GBCC says it hosts more than 75 events and meetings annually; its 2026 guide describes a monthly second-Tuesday Off the Clock networking happy hour, consistently 65+ attendees, complimentary appetizers, an open or cash bar option, and staff assistance securing a venue or co-sponsor. The calendar lists the December 15, 2026 Holiday Off the Clock at Landmark’s Bethesda Row Cinema, with appetizers supplied by hosts and registration closing at capacity. The January 26, 2027 Board Installation Reception and Annual Membership Meeting is listed as an upcoming special event, but no venue is published on the event page. Other published venue commitments show the Legislative Reception at The Bethesdan Hotel (December 1, 2026) and the 100th Anniversary Gala at Bethesda North Marriott Hotel & Conference Center (October 29, 2026); these should not be treated as open Marriott demand.
